subject: planner: Limit fine grained shuffle usage for mpp join operators to ensure shuffle keys are the same with actual join keys (#59884)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for planner/executor changes. `pkg/planner/core/optimizer.go` now only enables TiFlash fine-grained shuffle for MPP HashJoin build-side when `ExchangeSender.HashCols` exactly match the join build keys (same column UniqueID and order), preventing incorrect per-stream partitioning when exchange keys are casted differently than join keys. Added `TestIssue59877` in `pkg/executor/test/tiflashtest/tiflash_test.go` asserts (via `EXPLAIN format="brief"`) that fine-grained shuffle stream_count is not applied in the mixed-type join scenario that previously triggered the issue. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`; this core gating logic remains (no later corrective revert/fix indicating a flaw in this change).
